title: Energy-Flow Cosmology: Field Equations for Entropy-Driven Spacetime
abstract: Proposes a covariant field-theoretic framework where a normalized entropy field S(x) and an energy-flow four-vector J^μ source spacetime curvature alongside the metric. The action yields modified Einstein equations that reduce to GR when entropy gradients vanish, with cosmological and galactic-scale phenomenology that can mimic dark matter and alter late-time expansion.
